title: Regulation of lipid and lipoprotein metabolism by retinoids.
source_type: Journal of the American Academy of Dermatology
text_summary: 类维生素A是源自维生素A的小型亲脂性化合物，可影响多种发育和代谢过程。类视黄醇通过激活属于核受体视黄酸受体 (RAR) 和类视黄醇 X 受体 (RXR) 亚家族的转录因子来发挥作用。在治疗上，类维生素A用于治疗皮肤病和某些癌症。血脂异常是目前可用的类维生素A治疗的常见副作用。这篇综述总结了我们目前对类维生素A调节脂质和脂蛋白代谢的分子机制的理解。

         Regulation of lipid and lipoprotein
             metabolism by retinoids


                                     Bart Staels, PhD Lille, France


     Retinoids are small vitamin A–derived lipophilic compounds that influence a wide variety of developmental
    and metabolic processes. Retinoids exert their action by activating transcription factors belonging to the
      retinoic acid receptor (RAR) and retinoid X receptor (RXR) subfamilies of nuclear receptors. Therapeutically,
     retinoids are used for the treatment of dermatological disorders and certain cancers. Dyslipidemia is a
    common side-effect of therapy with the currently available retinoids. This review summarizes our current
     understanding of the molecular mechanisms of regulation of lipid and lipoprotein metabolism by retinoids.
      (J Am Acad Dermatol 2001;45:S158-67.)

image_summary:
Figure 1（PDF 第2页）：图 1. 类维生素A 的转录调控机制。方案总结了转录
RXR 和 RAR 核受体对不同反应元件的脚本作用。的
RXR 与 II 类核受体（RAR 除外）的相互作用通过 PPAR 和
LXR, 2 受体在脂质代谢中发挥作用。

Figure 2（PDF 第5页）：图 2. 类视黄醇对 HDL 载脂蛋白基因表达的调节。方案总结
类维生素A对肝脏apo A-I和apo A-II基因转录的调节涉及
核受体 RXR 和 RAR。
